page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is a general-purpose cloud server instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM hypervisor technology. It features a single physical Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz, providing 2 dedicated virtual CPUs through hyperthreading. The system includes 8.0 GB of RAM, offering a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB per core. Its cache hierarchy consists of 48 KB L1d cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 MB L3 cache. Hardware instruction extensions include AVX, AVX-512 with VNNI, alongside hardware-accelerated cryptography features such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps, contains no dedicated GPUs, and relies entirely on network storage, offering no local instance storage.

Performance profiles highlight distinct differences between single-threaded execution and multi-core operations. Single-core performance benchmarks, such as stress-ng (1842.18) and Geekbench (1556.0), place in the average tier, supported by solid single-threaded compression speeds of 27.62 GB/sec in gzip testing. However, overall multi-core performance metrics, including multi-threaded stress-ng (1932.39) and Geekbench multi-core (1815.0), fall into lower percentile tiers due to the constrained physical core count. Memory throughput shows uncached read speeds of 15.1 GB/sec and write speeds of 13.63 GB/sec. Synthetic database operations and Redis SET throughput (1.97 million ops/sec) also reflect performance constraints inherent to entry-level dual-vCPU configurations.

From an architectural cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7se.large provides dedicated CPU resource guarantees in a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM configuration without shared-core throttling risks. The primary trade-off centers on low absolute parallel processing capacity and modest memory bandwidth, making it less suitable for high-concurrency databases, compute-heavy rendering, or large-scale data processing. It is best suited for low-density workloads, including lightweight web microservices, small API gateways, single-threaded background tasks, utility nodes, and entry-level developer environments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is a general-purpose instance featuring an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz with 1 physical core and 2 dedicated vCPUs. It includes 8.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per core), 48 MB of L3 cache, and 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, with no local storage or onboard GPU. Supporting AVX-512 VNNI and AES cryptographic extensions, the server delivers solid single-threaded performance, achieving an average Geekbench single-core score of 1556.0 and stress-ng single-core score of 1842.18. However, due to its dual-vCPU limit, multi-core metrics, memory bandwidth (15.1 GB/sec uncached read), and database throughput fall into lower benchmark percentiles. With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM allocation, it offers cost-effective dedicated compute for lightweight web serving, small API gateways, utility tasks, and basic microservices.
